prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new 16:9 desktop cinematic keyframe, a premium photographed 1:120 scale handcrafted logistics miniature diorama. Reference image establishes exact scale craftsmanship, palette, bright daylight, tiny painted workers and macro tiltshift: maintain its refined realistic scale-model look, do not copy its Chinese setting. This is scene 05, now INSIDE the USA fulfillment warehouse, one continuous journey of same kraft cartons bound with CYAN straps.

CAMERA AND STORY: look down 35 degrees and diagonally along a LEFT-TO-RIGHT workflow. At far LEFT/back, glimpses of tall navy warehouse storage racks. Across CENTER, 3 small painted figurines actively scan and pack cyan-strapped kraft cartons on delicate miniature packing stations and a metal roller conveyor. Conveyor and cartons move visibly LEFT TO RIGHT, directly toward a large OPEN OUTBOUND DOOR at RIGHT. Through that right door visibly show an AMERICAN FLAG on a pole and a US long-hood tractor truck pointing toward the right and a broad suburban road with lowrise buildings beyond. Visible destination must connect the work inside to the US dispatch outside; avoid a disconnected collage. White wall panels and three navy steel portal bays unify this warehouse. Diorama has delicately modeled machinery and rivets, slight molded texture, faint beveled concrete model base edge at lower foreground. Keep all major subjects crisply legible and selective gentle foreground/background macro blur.

BRAND COMPOSITING SURFACE: large completely BLANK IVORY rectangular name panel mounted on the front vertical face of the prominent center-front packing station. It must be a clean natural physical object, clear view, long horizontal panel with width:height about 5.4:1, no occlusions, no writing or logos. Give it enough size for later logo overlay.

Bright diffuse daylight, pale whitegray concrete, navy steel, cyan accents and straps, kraft cargo. Entire 16:9 width is an inhabited coherent model world; no blank-left text zone. No diagram arrows, maps, captions, graphic overlays, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos, pseudotext or carrier identity. Especially no generated PNPLINE text. Tiny human figurines, precise model craftsmanship, unmistakably miniature not a fullsize warehouse photo. US flag and American long-hood truck communicate country context.
visual_findings: Packing conveyor links left storage through center workers to right outbound door; USA flag and long-hood truck visible; painted scale figures and shallow macro depth. Blank packing station panel clear. Exterior truck loading depiction is conceptual.
